title: Dia de Los Muertos and Diwali Festival
description: Please join us at the Crissy Field Center on Presidio Tunnel Tops for a family-friendly Día de los Muertos & Diwali event in the park.
long_description:
Please join us at the Crissy Field Center on Presidio Tunnel Tops for a family-friendly Día de los Muertos & Diwali event in the park.

About this Event

Observed annually in the fall season, these two distinct cultural celebrations come together in a national park to honor South Asian and Latinx traditions. Designed intentionally as a celebration and a learning opportunity, attendees are invited to participate in a wide range of activities that include arts and crafts, storytelling, cultural dance, song, and a fire ceremony, and learn about social and environmental justice issues in both cultures.
Hosted by the Presidio Trust and Parks Conservancy with Alliance for South Asians Taking Action.
Contact Miriam Manda with any accessibility needs at bW1hbmRhIHwgcHJlc2lkaW90cnVzdCAhIGdvdg== or 423.704.7187. For information on Presidio Tunnel Tops accessibility visit presidiotunneltops.gov/visit/access-and-inclusion.
